Tooltip_MinidoracatAnyCar_Dismantle: Cuts this vehicle into metalworking materials. The vehicle is gone for good. <LINE> Higher Welding skills will retrieve more usable salvage.
Tooltip_MinidoracatAnyCar_Animals: There are animals in the trailer
Tooltip_MinidoracatAnyCar_Strip: Removes every part you are able to remove, one by one, then dismantles the vehicle. This takes a long time.
Tooltip_MinidoracatAnyCar_Salvage: Broken parts work too. Higher skills find more.
Tooltip_MinidoracatAnyCar_TireSealant: Repairs a damaged tire. One can, one repair.
